observations: The runtime supplied no subagent/task identity, so task is null. I opened page-03.png with Read and looked at it.

03-1: the caption 'A later morning: patients can always check in at the front desk.' covers the left part of a small wall screen behind Meera. That screen shows only a blank white strip, carries no lettered text and is not a prop of this panel. Mr. Raman's face, Meera's face, her typing hands, his stick hand and the QR stand at left are all clear. I judge it not a defect.
03-2: the caption 'Some check in ahead on the Welbuk Health app.' ends just above Priya's hair. Her face, the tapping finger and the phone with calendar and check icons are clear.

03-3: the caption 'Ravi scans the QR code at the door.' overlaps only the top-left of Ravi's hair; his brows, eyes and mouth are below it. The QR stand, the phone with its scan frame and his hand on the bag strap are clear.
03-4: the caption 'A short form on his own phone, shared with consent.' sits left of Ravi's face and above the phone. The form fields, the tapped tick-box, the thumb and the wristwatch are clear.

03-5: the caption 'Every check-in gets a slot on the screen.' is on the plain upper-left wall. The 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' label sits inside the TV screen on its white strip, so it is on its screen. All three faces, the stick, both phones and the bag are clear.
The first reading's notes (c), hair continuity, and (d), the unnamed patients, concern art and source, not lettering.
Captions only. Natural scan: top-left, top-right, middle-left, middle-right, bottom caption, then the TV label. This is the script order.
Each caption is in its panel's top-left corner, so the left-to-right, row-by-row reading is unambiguous. The TV label is read last, as the result.

transitions.observation: The evening onboarding office cuts to the morning reception. 'A later morning' explicitly marks the time change. Meera is at the desk in the same blue kurta.
From front-desk check-in to a second way: Priya checks in on the app outside the same clinic, whose teal awning is visible.
Third way: Ravi is just inside the glass entrance at the QR stand. The reception seen behind him links to 03-1.
Close-up of the same phone after the scan, showing the form and tick-box. Same green sleeve and wristwatch.
All three patients from 03-1 to 03-4 now sit together under the TV. Ravi holds his phone, with the bag on his lap.

Same waiting room and wall TV. The list 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' becomes 'NOW · A-12' on the same screen, and Ravi stands with his bag back on his shoulder. The caption 'Soon, his slot comes up.' bridges the new page boundary.

readingReview.comparison: The first reading's order matches the script exactly, and the TV label is on its screen. Note (a), the 03-1 caption over the background screen, is real but covers only a blank strip with no information or label assigned, so I do not count it as a defect. Note (b), the 03-2 caption near Priya's hair, touches hair only. Notes (c) and (d) concern art and source. Both new boundaries (02-4→03-1 and 03-5→04-1) are bridged by captions and continuous props. Nothing unresolved remains.
